function.name: read_file
function.description: Returns the full contents of one existing file. One file per call. No globs, no directories, no recursion. May be refused.

path.description: Path to the file to read.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Replaces the entire contents of path with content. This is not an edit, patch, or append — whatever was there is gone. Read the file first if you need its current contents. Returns applied, or outcome unknown.

path.description: Path to the file to replace.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.
